approval.note: Plan section 10 requires zero policy and tenant-isolation violations; the other gates are the implementing agent's proposals. Not approved. Amended by the implementing agent on 2026-10-21: new gate same_tenant_overreach (security persona review). Still proposed.

gate_plan.purpose_violations: Policy and tenant-isolation violations 0 (a purpose the caller lacks)
gate_plan.separation_of_duties_violations: A requester or an agent decides a review: 0
gate_plan.same_tenant_overreach: A colleague in the same tenant reads another person's run or rows, or decides a review without the role: 0
gate_plan.unauthenticated_successes: Forged, expired, wrong-audience, or missing tokens that succeed: 0
gate_plan.probe_agreement: Every hostile probe is refused without leaking the victim's data
gate_plan.protected_case_failures: ADS-070 policy-denied, tenant-isolation, and refusal cases that fail: 0

open_findings: F-02: Run IDs were a plain hash of tenant, user, purpose, and a client-chosen key, so a colleague could compute and read another person's run
F-03: Small cohorts and exact differencing: aggregates can reveal individual values

not_measured.independent_security_review: required by the plan before any pilot; this matrix is not one
not_measured.live_identity_provider: tokens are signed by a local issuer; a real IdP's behaviour (key rotation, group claims, token exchange) is not exercised
not_measured.automated_actor_naming: a caller is treated as automated only if its user id has a known prefix (system:, model:, agent:, service:) or carries a delegation claim; an automated actor with an ordinary-looking id would be treated as a human reviewer. Identity-provider configuration must enforce the convention.
not_measured.network_and_infrastructure: no network boundary, storage encryption, or deployment isolation is tested
not_measured.data_plane_boundary: the VPC simulator (ADS-064) is covered by its own tests, not this matrix
